## Summary

Experimental setup. We use emergency department (ED) encounters for Florida counties from the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA), tabulated by the data provider around the impact date of each tropical cyclone (TC). Each TC is buffered by its radius of maximum winds (RMW) from the IBTrACS tracks to make a wind swath, and a county is exposed to a TC when any part of the county falls within the swath. For each exposed county we label three storm phases: Threat (the 7 days before impact), Impact (the impact day), and Cleanup (the 7 days after impact). The reference (None) weeks are hurricane-season county-weeks that contain no storm-phase day for any TC at the same wind threshold. We fit a fixed-effects Poisson model where the dependent variable is the encounter count in each county window, the fixed effects are county and year-month, the logarithm of the window length (days) is an offset so the 1-day Impact window and the 7-day windows are on the same per-day scale, and the standard errors are clustered by county and year-month. The model is fit separately for all-cause encounters, ten cause-specific categories, and four age groups, at three wind thresholds (≥34, ≥55, and ≥64 kt). The study period is 2005–2023 (40, 20, and 11 TCs at the three thresholds).

Results. See the Results tables section at the end of the document. Every number reported in the manuscript is collected there and written to `outputs/results_tables/`.

## Settings and data locations

The data folders are set here and nowhere else. `Ed_county_weekly_confidential` holds the AHCA encounter files, which are not public and are not included with the code. `Ed_county_weekly_public` holds the IBTrACS storm tracks (downloaded from NOAA if missing) and the USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes. The Florida county boundaries are downloaded by `tigris`.

Injury encounters are identified from the first external-cause (E) code, the same definition used in the weekly baseline file. The storm-aligned injury file `ED_Injuries_FirstEcode.csv` is the provider's ≥34 and ≥55 kt extract under that definition, with ≥64 kt rows added by `build_injury_64kt_from_march.R`: a storm's rows depend only on its impact date, so the ≥64 kt rows are the storm's ≥55 kt rows wherever the two impact dates agree (all storms in the study period). A later extract that also counted other code positions (`ED_Injuries.csv`) does not match the baseline and is not used.
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(tigris)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(broom)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

begin_year      <- 2004
end_year        <- 2024 
storm_end_date  <- as.Date("2023-12-31")  
# Note: ED Data for 2004 2024 are not available, as a result, we only include analysis from 2005 to 2023 
none_end_date   <- as.Date("2023-12-31")  # same end date for the baseline weeks
threshold_use   <- 34L                    # primary wind threshold (kt)
thresholds      <- c(34L, 55L, 64L)
n_cleanup_weeks <- 1                      # Cleanup = post-impact week 1 (days 1-7)

conf_dir    <- here::here("Ed_county_weekly_confidential")   # AHCA encounter files
public_dir  <- here::here("Ed_county_weekly_public")         # IBTrACS tracks and USDA codes
ed_dir      <- conf_dir                                      # all-cause files
cat_dir     <- conf_dir                                      # category and age files
ns_dir      <- conf_dir                                      # weekly baseline files
ibtracs_dir <- public_dir
rucc_file   <- file.path(public_dir, "Ruralurbancontinuumcodes2023.csv")

storm_aligned_file  <- file.path(ed_dir, "ED_AllCause.csv")   # provider file ED_Cyclones_AllCause_by_County_34kt55kt64kt_Threat1_Threat4_Threat7_PostWeekly_2yr.csv
daily_allcause_path <- file.path(ed_dir, "ER_AllCause_County_by_Day_05_24.csv")
category_file <- function(short_name)                          # storm-aligned file for each category
  file.path(cat_dir, if (short_name == "Injuries") "ED_Injuries_FirstEcode.csv" else paste0("ED_", short_name, ".csv")) #Here we appled a fix that reconciles Injuries data with baseline reference

fig_dir <- here::here("figs")
out_dir <- here::here("outputs")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Input consistency check

The storm-aligned files and the baseline files are separate extracts from the provider, and they must count encounters the same way, otherwise the phase coefficients absorb the difference between the extracts. Every 7-day post-impact window in a storm-aligned file covers a calendar week that also appears in the baseline file, so the two counts can be compared directly. All-cause windows are compared with the daily file summed over the same 7 days; cause-specific and age windows are compared with the weekly baseline files (Sunday to Saturday). The weekly age baseline reports 18–44 and 45–64 separately, and a count of 5 or fewer is suppressed (the row is absent), so when one of the two is missing the summed 18–64 count can be 1 to 5 lower than the storm-aligned 18–64 count. Those weeks are counted as explained by suppression. Any other difference stops the document.
```{r}
week_windows <- function(path) {   # 7-day post-impact windows, one row per county-week
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(window_start = as.Date(window_start), window_end = as.Date(window_end),
                  County = as.integer(County)) |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, grepl("^Post_Week", Window),
                  as.integer(window_end - window_start) == 6) |>
    dplyr::distinct(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(c("County", "window_start", "AgeGroup"))), Visits)
}

compare_counts <- function(storm, base, label) {
  keys <- intersect(c("County", "window_start", "AgeGroup"), names(base))
  j <- dplyr::inner_join(storm, base, by = keys) |>
    dplyr::mutate(diff = Visits - base,
                  suppressed = !is.na(n_parts) & n_parts < 2 & diff >= 1 & diff <= 5)
  tibble::tibble(input          = label,
                 weeks_compared = nrow(j),
                 equal          = sum(j$diff == 0),
                 suppressed     = sum(j$diff != 0 & j$suppressed),
                 unexplained    = sum(j$diff != 0 & !j$suppressed),
                 conflicting    = sum(duplicated(storm[keys])))
}

# All-cause: storm-aligned windows vs the daily file summed over the same 7 days
daily7 <- readr::read_csv(daily_allcause_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::transmute(County = as.integer(County), Date = as.Date(Date), Visits) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99) |>
  dplyr::arrange(County, Date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(County) |>
  tidyr::complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "day")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(base = Visits + dplyr::lead(Visits, 1) + dplyr::lead(Visits, 2) + dplyr::lead(Visits, 3) +
                       dplyr::lead(Visits, 4) + dplyr::lead(Visits, 5) + dplyr::lead(Visits, 6)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(base)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(County, window_start = Date, base, n_parts = NA_integer_)
input_check <- compare_counts(week_windows(storm_aligned_file), daily7, "All-cause")

# Cause-specific: storm-aligned windows vs the weekly category baseline
cat_base <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ns_dir, "Combined_ER_Weekly_By_County_DiseaseCategories.csv"),
                            show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(County = as.integer(County), window_start = as.Date(Week)) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Category, County, window_start) |>
  dplyr::summarize(base = sum(Weekly_Visits), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_parts = NA_integer_)

check_files <- c(CVD = "cardiovascular", Diabetes = "diabetes", Digestive = "digestive",
                 Endocrine = "endocrine", Infectious = "infectious", Injuries = "injuries",
                 Neoplasms = "neoplasms", Neuropsych = "neuropsych", Renal = "renal",
                 Respiratory = "respiratory")
for (k in names(check_files)) {
  input_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(input_check, compare_counts(
    week_windows(category_file(k)),
    cat_base |> dplyr::filter(Category == check_files[[k]]) |> dplyr::select(-Category),
    check_files[[k]]))
}

# Age groups: storm-aligned windows vs the weekly age baseline (18-44 and 45-64 summed)
age_base <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ns_dir, "ER_AllCause_AgeGroups_County_Weekly.csv"),
                            show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(County = as.integer(County), window_start = as.Date(Week),
                AgeGroup = dplyr::case_when(AgeGroup == "0_to_4"                    ~ "Under 5",
                                            AgeGroup == "5_to_17"                   ~ "5 to 17",
                                            AgeGroup %in% c("18_to_44", "45_to_64") ~ "18 to 64",
                                            AgeGroup == "65+"                       ~ "Over 65")) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, !is.na(AgeGroup)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(AgeGroup, County, window_start) |>
  dplyr::summarize(base = sum(Visits), n_parts = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_parts = ifelse(AgeGroup == "18 to 64", n_parts, NA_integer_))
input_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(input_check, compare_counts(
  week_windows(file.path(cat_dir, "ED_Age_Cats.csv")), age_base, "Age groups"))

readr::write_csv(input_check, file.path(out_dir, "input_consistency_check.csv"))
as.data.frame(input_check)

bad <- input_check |> dplyr::filter(unexplained > 0 | conflicting > 0)
if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
  stop("Storm-aligned and baseline counts differ for the same county-weeks: ",
       paste0(bad$input, " (", bad$unexplained, " of ", bad$weeks_compared, " weeks)", collapse = "; "),
       ". The extracts do not count encounters the same way; fix the input files before fitting.")
}
```

## Storm swaths and exposed counties

Get and import the IBTrACS storm tracks
```{r}
L <- "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/international-best-track-archive-for-climate-stewardship-ibtracs/v04r01/access/shapefile/IBTrACS.NA.list.v04r01.lines.zip"

if(!"IBTrACS.NA.list.v04r01.lines.zip" %in% list.files(ibtracs_dir)) {
  dir.create(ibtracs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  download.file(url = L,
                destfile = file.path(ibtracs_dir, "IBTrACS.NA.list.v04r01.lines.zip"))
  unzip(file.path(ibtracs_dir, "IBTrACS.NA.list.v04r01.lines.zip"),
        exdir = ibtracs_dir)
}

Tracks.sf <- sf::st_read(dsn = ibtracs_dir,
                         layer = "IBTrACS.NA.list.v04r01.lines",
                         quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(crs = 32616) |>   # UTM 16N for buffering in meters
  dplyr::filter(year >= begin_year, year <= end_year)
```

Build the swath for each storm at each wind threshold and find the counties it intersects. Track segments at or above the threshold are kept, missing RMW values are filled in three passes (storm mean, then central pressure mean, then storm mean again), each segment is buffered by its RMW, and the buffers are dissolved to one polygon per storm. Any overlap with a county counts as exposure.
```{r}
counties_utm.sf <- tigris::counties(state = "FL", year = 2020, cb = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(crs = 32616) |>
  dplyr::select(county_fips = GEOID) |>
  dplyr::left_join(ahca_fips, by = "county_fips")

build_swath_lookup <- function(thresh) {
  tr <- Tracks.sf |>
    dplyr::filter(USA_WIND >= thresh) |>
    dplyr::select(SID, USA_WIND, USA_PRES, USA_RMW) |>
    dplyr::group_by(SID) |>       # pedigree
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(USA_PRES) |>  # minimum pressure
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(SID) |>       # pedigree
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(USA_RMW))

  sw <- sf::st_buffer(tr, dist = tr$USA_RMW * 1852) |>  # 1852 converts nautical miles to meters
    dplyr::group_by(SID) |>
    dplyr::summarize(.groups = "drop")

  idx <- sf::st_intersects(sw, counties_utm.sf)
  tibble::tibble(
    SID             = rep(sw$SID, lengths(idx)),
    ahca_code       = counties_utm.sf$ahca_code[unlist(idx)],
    threshold_knots = thresh
  ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
}

swath_county <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, build_swath_lookup)

# Keep only the storm x county rows whose county intersects the storm's swath
apply_swath_filter <- function(df, county_col = "County") {
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(.ahca = as.integer(.data[[county_col]])) |>
    dplyr::semi_join(swath_county, by = c("SID" = "SID",
                                          ".ahca" = "ahca_code",
                                          "threshold_knots" = "threshold_knots")) |>
    dplyr::select(-.ahca)
}
```

## All-cause ED encounters

The provider file has one row per storm, county, threshold, and window (Threat_7d, Landfall_Day0, and Post_Week_1 to Post_Week_105), and every storm is tabulated against all 67 counties. `ED_allcause_state` keeps all counties and is used only in the section on the Threat phase without a swath. `ED_allcause` keeps the counties inside each storm's swath and is used everywhere else. Counts stay raw; the window length goes into the model as an offset.
```{r}
ED_allcause_state <- readr::read_csv(storm_aligned_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    impact_date  = as.Date(impact_date),
    window_start = as.Date(window_start),
    window_end   = as.Date(window_end),
    County       = as.integer(County)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(impact_date <= storm_end_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(window_days = as.integer(window_end - window_start) + 1L)

ED_allcause <- ED_allcause_state |>
  apply_swath_filter(county_col = "County")

ED_allcause |>
  dplyr::filter(threshold_knots == threshold_use, Window == "Threat_7d") |>
  dplyr::count(SID, name = "n_counties") |>
  dplyr::summarize(storms = dplyr::n(), min = min(n_counties),
                   median = median(n_counties), max = max(n_counties))
```

Label the storm phases at the primary threshold. Only hurricane-season (May–November) windows are kept. When two storms give the same county the same phase in the same week, the row with more encounters is kept.
```{r}
storm_obs <- ED_allcause |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == threshold_use) |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
    Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
    Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                      ~ "Impact",
    !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
    TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect)) |>
  dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
  dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
  dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
  dplyr::select(SID, ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days,
                effect, window_start, year_month) |>
  dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, window_start, effect) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(Visits, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

table(storm_obs$effect)
```

## Non-TC (None) baseline

Flag every county-week that contains a storm-phase day for any storm at the primary threshold. Two keys are kept: Monday-anchored weeks for the all-cause baseline built from the daily file, and Sunday-anchored weeks for the provider's weekly files, which are tabulated Sunday to Saturday.
```{r}
storm_active_days <- ED_allcause |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == threshold_use) |>
  dplyr::filter(Window %in% c("Threat_7d", "Threat_4d", "Threat_1d", "Landfall_Day0") |
                (!is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks)) |>
  dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(dates = list(seq(window_start, window_end, by = "day"))) |>
  tidyr::unnest(dates) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(week_mon = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 1)),
                week_sun = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 7))) |>
  dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon, week_sun)

storm_active_weeks <- storm_active_days |>
  dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
  dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
storm_active_weeks_sun <- storm_active_days |>
  dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun) |>
  dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
```

Aggregate the daily all-cause file to complete Monday-anchored weeks, remove the storm-active weeks, and keep hurricane-season weeks. Days with 5 or fewer encounters are suppressed by AHCA and are absent from the daily file, so requiring complete weeks also removes any week containing a suppressed day. Weeks with 42 or fewer encounters are also dropped.
```{r}
daily_raw <- readr::read_csv(daily_allcause_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Date = as.Date(Date), County = as.integer(County)) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99,
                Date >= as.Date(paste0(begin_year, "-01-01")),
                Date <= as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-12-31"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(ahca_code = County,
                week_mon  = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(Date, unit = "week", week_start = 1)))

weekly_allcause_ns <- daily_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
  dplyr::summarize(Visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), n_days = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_days == 7)

none_obs <- weekly_allcause_ns |>
  dplyr::left_join(storm_active_weeks, by = c("ahca_code", "week_mon")) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
  dplyr::select(-storm_active) |>
  dplyr::filter(Visits > 42) |>
  dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11,
                week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect       = "None",
                window_days  = 7L,
                window_start = week_mon,
                year_month   = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                county_fe    = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
  dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

nrow(none_obs)
```

## All-cause model

Stack the storm-phase and None observations and fit the fixed-effects Poisson model at the primary threshold. The coefficients are log rate ratios relative to None weeks in the same county and year-month. This model supplies the all-cause row of Table 1 and the true estimates for the falsification test.
```{r}
ED_panel <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  storm_obs |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days,
                             effect, window_start, year_month),
  none_obs  |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days,
                             effect, window_start, year_month)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat", "Impact")),
                year_month = factor(year_month),
                county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))

m_allcause <- fixest::fepois(
  Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
  offset  = ~ log(window_days),
  data    = ED_panel,
  cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month
)

summary(m_allcause)
```

## All-cause phase effects by wind threshold (Figure 2)

Repeat the model at each threshold. The storm phases, the storm-active mask, and the None weeks are all rebuilt for the threshold. The `ed` argument defaults to the swath-filtered file; the section on the Threat phase without a swath passes the statewide file instead.
```{r}
fit_allcause_threshold <- function(thresh, threat_window, n_cleanup, ed = ED_allcause) {
  storm_obs_t <- ed |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == threat_window                                  ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                     ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month) |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, window_start, effect) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(Visits, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  mask_t <- ed |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::filter(Window %in% c("Threat_7d", "Threat_4d", "Threat_1d", "Landfall_Day0") |
                  (!is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup)) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(dates = list(seq(window_start, window_end, by = "day"))) |>
    tidyr::unnest(dates) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 1))) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)

  none_t <- weekly_allcause_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(Visits > 42, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_t, by = c("ahca_code", "week_mon")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::select(-storm_active) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect       = "None",
                  window_days  = 7L,
                  window_start = week_mon,
                  year_month   = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                  county_fe    = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

  panel_t <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_obs_t, none_t) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat", "Impact")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))

  fit <- fixest::fepois(
    Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
    offset  = ~ log(window_days),
    data    = panel_t,
    cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month
  )

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                  pct_change   = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
                  pct_ci_lo    = 100 * (exp(conf.low) - 1),
                  pct_ci_hi    = 100 * (exp(conf.high) - 1),
                  threshold    = thresh) |>
    dplyr::select(threshold, effect_label, pct_change, pct_ci_lo, pct_ci_hi, p.value)
}

fig_dat <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, fit_allcause_threshold,
                          threat_window = "Threat_7d",
                          n_cleanup     = n_cleanup_weeks) |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect_label = factor(effect_label, levels = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup")),
                threshold    = factor(paste0("≥", threshold, " kt"),
                                      levels = paste0("≥", thresholds, " kt")))

p_multi <- ggplot(fig_dat, aes(x = effect_label, y = pct_change)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray55") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_ci_lo, ymax = pct_ci_hi),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~ threshold, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "% change in weekly ED encounters vs non-TC baseline",
       caption = paste0("All-cause, RMW corridor exposure. Points: Poisson FE ",
                        "estimates; bars: 95% CIs")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"))
p_multi

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure2_allcause_phases_by_threshold.png"),
       p_multi, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
# JESEE artwork, PDF copies only (the PNG files and plot objects above are unchanged): at the
# journal's two-column width (175-178 mm) text must be 5-7 pt and lines at least 1 pt, and
# explanatory notes belong in the figure legend rather than inside the image.
jesee_lines <- function(p, min_lw) {  # raise every layer's line width to at least min_lw (mm)
  p$layers <- lapply(p$layers, function(l) {
    l  <- structure(rlang::env_clone(l), class = class(l))  # copy the layer; the original plot is not modified
    lw <- l$aes_params$linewidth
    if (is.null(lw)) lw <- l$geom$default_aes$linewidth
    if (is.numeric(lw) && lw < min_lw) l$aes_params$linewidth <- min_lw
    if (inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint")) {  # outline of plotted points: same minimum as the lines
      st <- l$aes_params$stroke
      if (is.null(st)) st <- l$geom$default_aes$stroke
      st_min <- min_lw * ggplot2::.pt * 2 / ggplot2::.stroke
      if (is.numeric(st) && st < st_min) l$aes_params$stroke <- st_min
    }
    l
  })
  p
}
p_multi_pdf <- jesee_lines(p_multi, 0.75) + labs(caption = NULL) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9.8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.75))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure2_allcause_phases_by_threshold.pdf"),
       p_multi_pdf, width = 10, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
```

## Cause-specific models (Figure 3)

Load the ten cause-specific storm-aligned files and apply the same swath filter.
```{r}
cat_files <- c(CVD = "cardiovascular", Diabetes = "diabetes", Digestive = "digestive",
               Endocrine = "endocrine", Infectious = "infectious", Injuries = "injuries",
               Neoplasms = "neoplasms", Neuropsych = "neuropsych", Renal = "renal",
               Respiratory = "respiratory")

read_ed_category <- function(short_name) {
  readr::read_csv(category_file(short_name),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(as.Date(impact_date) <= storm_end_date) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Category     = unname(cat_files[short_name]),
                  impact_date  = as.Date(impact_date),
                  window_start = as.Date(window_start),
                  window_end   = as.Date(window_end),
                  County       = as.integer(County),
                  window_days  = as.integer(window_end - window_start) + 1L) |>
    apply_swath_filter(county_col = "County")
}

ED_disease <- purrr::map_dfr(names(cat_files), read_ed_category)
table(ED_disease$Category)
```

Load the weekly non-storm category file for the None weeks. The provider weeks run Sunday to Saturday; `week_mon` (Sunday + 1) is the week label. The week of 2015-09-27 spans the change from ICD-9 to ICD-10 on 1 October 2015 and is reported under both coding systems, so the counts are summed over `ICD_Type` to give one observation per county-week.
```{r}
combined_ns <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ns_dir, "Combined_ER_Weekly_By_County_DiseaseCategories.csv"),
                               show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99) |>
  dplyr::mutate(County    = as.integer(County),
                ahca_code = County,
                week_mon  = as.Date(Week) + 1L,
                Visits    = Weekly_Visits) |>
  dplyr::filter(ahca_code >= 1L, ahca_code <= 67L,
                as.Date(Week) >= as.Date(paste0(begin_year, "-01-01")),
                as.Date(Week) <= as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-12-31")),
                week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Category, ahca_code, week_mon) |>
  dplyr::summarize(Visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

Fit one model per category. The None weeks come from the category's own weekly file with the Sunday-keyed storm-active weeks removed.
```{r}
fit_disease_model <- function(df_cat, thresh, n_cleanup) {
  cat_name <- unique(df_cat$Category)
  empty <- tibble::tibble(Category = cat_name, effect_label = NA_character_,
                          pct_change = NA_real_, pct_ci_lo = NA_real_,
                          pct_ci_hi = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)

  storm_cat <- df_cat |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                    ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                     ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

  none_cat <- combined_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(Category == cat_name) |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_sun = week_mon - 1L) |>
    dplyr::left_join(storm_active_weeks_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::select(-storm_active, -week_sun) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect       = "None",
                  window_days  = 7L,
                  window_start = week_mon,
                  year_month   = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                  county_fe    = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)
  if (nrow(none_cat) == 0) return(empty)

  panel <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_cat, none_cat) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat", "Impact")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))
  if (nrow(panel) < 50 || length(unique(panel$effect)) < 2) return(empty)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                   offset  = ~ log(window_days),
                   data    = panel,
                   cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(empty)

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Category     = cat_name,
                  effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                  pct_change   = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
                  pct_ci_lo    = 100 * (exp(conf.low) - 1),
                  pct_ci_hi    = 100 * (exp(conf.high) - 1)) |>
    dplyr::select(Category, effect_label, pct_change, pct_ci_lo, pct_ci_hi, p.value)
}
```

The storm-active weeks depend on the threshold, so they are rebuilt inside the loop over thresholds and restored to the primary threshold afterwards. `build_disease_mask()` is also used by the age models and the maps.
```{r}
build_disease_mask <- function(thresh, n_cleanup, ed = ED_allcause) {
  ed |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::filter(Window %in% c("Threat_7d", "Threat_4d", "Threat_1d", "Landfall_Day0") |
                  (!is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup)) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(dates = list(seq(window_start, window_end, by = "day"))) |>
    tidyr::unnest(dates) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 1)),
                  week_sun = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 7))) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon, week_sun)
}

storm_active_weeks_main     <- storm_active_weeks
storm_active_weeks_sun_main <- storm_active_weeks_sun

disease_results_all <- list()
for (th in thresholds) {
  mask_days <- build_disease_mask(th, n_cleanup_weeks)
  storm_active_weeks <- mask_days |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
  storm_active_weeks_sun <- mask_days |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
  disease_results_all[[as.character(th)]] <- ED_disease |>
    dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
    dplyr::group_split() |>
    purrr::map_dfr(fit_disease_model, thresh = th, n_cleanup = n_cleanup_weeks) |>
    dplyr::mutate(threshold_knots = th)
}
disease_results_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(disease_results_all)

storm_active_weeks     <- storm_active_weeks_main
storm_active_weeks_sun <- storm_active_weeks_sun_main
```

## Age groups (Figure 4)

Load the age-stratified storm-aligned file and apply the swath filter.
```{r}
age_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(cat_dir, "ED_Age_Cats.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(as.Date(impact_date) <= storm_end_date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(impact_date  = as.Date(impact_date),
                window_start = as.Date(window_start),
                window_end   = as.Date(window_end),
                County       = as.integer(County),
                window_days  = as.integer(window_end - window_start) + 1L,
                SubgroupCol  = AgeGroup) |>
  apply_swath_filter(county_col = "County")

age_levels <- c("Under 5", "5 to 17", "18 to 64", "Over 65")
table(age_df$SubgroupCol)
```

Load the weekly non-storm age file for the None weeks. Its age groups are mapped to the storm-aligned groups (18–44 and 45–64 are summed to 18–64).
```{r}
age_ns <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ns_dir, "ER_AllCause_AgeGroups_County_Weekly.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99) |>
  dplyr::mutate(County    = as.integer(County),
                ahca_code = County,
                week_mon  = as.Date(Week) + 1L,
                AgeGroup_harmonised = dplyr::case_when(
                  AgeGroup == "0_to_4"                    ~ "Under 5",
                  AgeGroup == "5_to_17"                   ~ "5 to 17",
                  AgeGroup %in% c("18_to_44", "45_to_64") ~ "18 to 64",
                  AgeGroup == "65+"                       ~ "Over 65",
                  TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(AgeGroup_harmonised),
                ahca_code >= 1L, ahca_code <= 67L,
                as.Date(Week) >= as.Date(paste0(begin_year, "-01-01")),
                as.Date(Week) <= as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-12-31")),
                week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, week_mon, AgeGroup_harmonised) |>
  dplyr::summarize(Visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::rename(SubgroupCol = AgeGroup_harmonised)
```

Fit one model per age group at each threshold. The model is the same as for the cause-specific categories.
```{r}
fit_age_model <- function(df_sub, thresh, n_cleanup) {
  subgroup_name <- unique(df_sub$SubgroupCol)
  empty <- tibble::tibble(Subgroup = subgroup_name, effect_label = NA_character_,
                          pct_change = NA_real_, pct_ci_lo = NA_real_,
                          pct_ci_hi = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)

  storm_sub <- df_sub |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                    ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                     ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

  none_sub <- age_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(SubgroupCol == subgroup_name) |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_sun = week_mon - 1L) |>
    dplyr::left_join(storm_active_weeks_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::select(-storm_active, -week_sun) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect       = "None",
                  window_days  = 7L,
                  window_start = week_mon,
                  year_month   = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                  county_fe    = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)
  if (nrow(none_sub) == 0 | nrow(storm_sub) == 0) return(empty)

  panel <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_sub, none_sub) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat", "Impact")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))
  if (nrow(panel) < 50 || length(unique(panel$effect)) < 2) return(empty)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                   offset  = ~ log(window_days),
                   data    = panel,
                   cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(empty)

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Subgroup     = subgroup_name,
                  effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                  pct_change   = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
                  pct_ci_lo    = 100 * (exp(conf.low) - 1),
                  pct_ci_hi    = 100 * (exp(conf.high) - 1)) |>
    dplyr::select(Subgroup, effect_label, pct_change, pct_ci_lo, pct_ci_hi, p.value)
}

age_results_all <- list()
for (th in thresholds) {
  mask_days <- build_disease_mask(th, n_cleanup_weeks)
  storm_active_weeks_sun <- mask_days |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
  age_results_all[[as.character(th)]] <- age_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(SubgroupCol) |>
    dplyr::group_split() |>
    purrr::map_dfr(fit_age_model, thresh = th, n_cleanup = n_cleanup_weeks) |>
    dplyr::mutate(threshold_knots = th)
}
age_results_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(age_results_all)

storm_active_weeks_sun <- storm_active_weeks_sun_main
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
                Subgroup      = factor(as.character(Subgroup), levels = rev(age_levels))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_change, y = Subgroup, colour = threshold_lab, shape = threshold_lab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray55") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = pct_ci_lo, xmax = pct_ci_hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                  size = 0.35, linewidth = 0.55) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("≥34 kt" = "#0072B2", "≥55 kt" = "#D55E00", "≥64 kt" = "#009E73"),
                      name = "Wind threshold") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("≥34 kt" = 16, "≥55 kt" = 17, "≥64 kt" = 15),
                     name = "Wind threshold") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.1, size = 0.9))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Over 65" = "65 and older")) +   # display label only; the data group stays "Over 65"
  facet_wrap(~ effect_label, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "% change in weekly ED encounters vs non-TC baseline", y = NULL,
       caption = "Points: Poisson FE estimates; bars: 95% CIs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
        panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"))
p_age_all

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure4_age_groups_by_threshold.png"), p_age_all,
```

## Exposure examples (Figure 1)

Two worked examples of the exposure rule at ≥34 kt: Ian (2022) crosses the peninsula and Michael (2018) strikes the Panhandle. Each map shows the track, the RMW swath, and the counties the swath intersects. The swath is built the same way as in the lookup above.
```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
fig_thresh <- 34L
fig_storms <- tibble::tribble(
  ~sid,            ~label,
  "2022266N12294", "Ian (2022)",
  "2018280N18273", "Michael (2018)")

fig_build <- function(sid, label) {
  tr <- Tracks.sf |>
    dplyr::filter(SID == sid, USA_WIND >= fig_thresh) |>
    dplyr::select(SID, USA_WIND, USA_PRES, USA_RMW) |>
    dplyr::group_by(SID) |>
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(USA_PRES) |>
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(SID) |>
    dplyr::mutate(USA_RMW = ifelse(is.na(USA_RMW), mean(USA_RMW, na.rm = TRUE), USA_RMW)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(USA_RMW))
  sw <- sf::st_buffer(tr, dist = tr$USA_RMW * 1852) |>
    sf::st_union() |>
    sf::st_sf(geometry = _)
  hit <- counties_utm.sf$ahca_code[lengths(sf::st_intersects(counties_utm.sf, sw)) > 0]
  list(track = sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_union(tr)) |> dplyr::mutate(storm = label),
       swath = sw |> dplyr::mutate(storm = label),
       hit   = hit, label = label)
}
fig_parts <- purrr::map2(fig_storms$sid, fig_storms$label, fig_build)

fig_extent <- sf::st_bbox(counties_utm.sf)

for (p in fig_parts) {
  gp <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = counties_utm.sf |>
              dplyr::mutate(exposed = ifelse(ahca_code %in% p$hit, "Exposed", "Not exposed")),
            aes(fill = exposed), colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.18) +
    geom_sf(data = p$swath, fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.22, colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_sf(data = p$track, colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Exposed" = "#F6C9A8", "Not exposed" = "grey93"), name = NULL) +
    coord_sf(xlim = fig_extent[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = fig_extent[c("ymin", "ymax")]) +
    labs(title = p$label) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5))
  print(gp)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("Figure1_exposure_%s.png", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", p$label))),
         gp, width = 6.5, height = 6.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  cat(p$label, "exposed counties:", length(p$hit), "\n")
}
```

## Storm counts and ED volume by county (Figures S1 and S2)

Storm-phase observations and None weeks at one threshold, built the same way as in the models. Rows without an encounter count (2004 storms whose phase weeks come before the ED data) are dropped. The analyzed storms are the storms that contribute phase rows with data.
```{r}
map_phase_obs <- function(th) {
  ED_allcause |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == th, !is.na(Visits)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                      ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, window_start, effect) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(Visits, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

map_none_weeks <- function(th) {
  mask_t <- build_disease_mask(th, n_cleanup_weeks) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)
  weekly_allcause_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(Visits > 42, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_t, by = c("ahca_code", "week_mon")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11)
}

analyzed_sids <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) sort(unique(map_phase_obs(th)$SID)))
names(analyzed_sids) <- thresholds
lengths(analyzed_sids)
```

## County phase effects (Figure 5)

For each county and phase, compare the observed encounters with the encounters expected from the county's None weeks in the same year-month (or the same year when that month has no None week). The expected count is the per-day None rate times the window length.
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
phase_ratio <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, function(th) {
  ph <- map_phase_obs(th) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                  yr         = lubridate::year(window_start))
  none <- map_none_weeks(th) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                  yr         = lubridate::year(week_mon))
  exp_ym <- none |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, year_month) |>
    dplyr::summarize(exp_daily_ym = sum(Visits) / (7 * dplyr::n()), .groups = "drop")
  exp_yr <- none |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, yr) |>
    dplyr::summarize(exp_daily_yr = sum(Visits) / (7 * dplyr::n()), .groups = "drop")
  ph |>
    dplyr::left_join(exp_ym, by = c("ahca_code", "year_month")) |>
    dplyr::left_join(exp_yr, by = c("ahca_code", "yr")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(exp_daily = dplyr::coalesce(exp_daily_ym, exp_daily_yr)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(exp_daily)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, effect) |>
    dplyr::summarize(obs = sum(Visits), expct = sum(exp_daily * window_days), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct_diff = 100 * (obs / expct - 1), threshold = th)
})

s3_sf <- fl_counties_geo |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    tidyr::crossing(ahca_fips |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fips),
                    threshold = thresholds,
                    effect = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup")) |>
      dplyr::left_join(phase_ratio, by = c("ahca_code", "threshold", "effect")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(effect        = factor(effect, levels = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup")),
                    threshold_lab = factor(paste0("≥", threshold, " kt"),
                                           levels = paste0("≥", thresholds, " kt"))),
    by = "county_fips")

# Counties crossed by a corridor at a threshold but without a reportable count in a phase are hatched
# (at >=64 kt: Glades and Lafayette, Impact phase); counties not crossed at that threshold stay gray.
s3_crossed <- phase_ratio |> dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, threshold)
s3_nocount <- s3_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(pct_diff)) |>
  dplyr::semi_join(s3_crossed, by = c("ahca_code", "threshold"))
hatch_sf <- function(poly, spacing = 9000) {  # diagonal lines clipped to the polygons, in metres (EPSG:3086)
  pp   <- sf::st_transform(poly, 3086)
  bb   <- sf::st_bbox(pp)
  span <- max(bb[["xmax"]] - bb[["xmin"]], bb[["ymax"]] - bb[["ymin"]])
  offs <- seq(-span, span, by = spacing)
  lns  <- sf::st_sfc(lapply(offs, function(o) sf::st_linestring(matrix(
            c(bb[["xmin"]] + o, bb[["ymin"]], bb[["xmin"]] + o + span, bb[["ymin"]] + span), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))),
            crs = 3086)
  h <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(pp, sf::st_sf(geometry = lns)))
  sf::st_transform(h, sf::st_crs(poly))
}
s3_hatch <- if (nrow(s3_nocount) > 0) hatch_sf(s3_nocount) else NULL

s3_stops <- c(-25, -12, -6, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 6, 12, 25)  # dense near zero, sparse in the tails

p_s3 <- ggplot(s3_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_diff), color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.12) +
  list(if (!is.null(s3_hatch)) geom_sf(data = s3_nocount, fill = "white", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.12),
       if (!is.null(s3_hatch)) geom_sf(data = s3_hatch, color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.3)) +
  facet_grid(threshold_lab ~ effect) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#2166ac", "#4393c3", "#92c5de", "#d1e5f0", "#f7f7f7",
                "#fddbc7", "#f4a582", "#d6604d", "#b2182b"),
    values  = scales::rescale(s3_stops, from = c(-25, 25)),
    limits  = c(-25, 25), oob = scales::squish,
    breaks  = c(-25, -12, -6, 0, 6, 12, 25),
    name    = "% difference\nvs expected",
    na.value = "gray85",
    guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = grid::unit(5, "cm"))) +
  labs(caption = "All-cause, RMW corridor exposure. Gray: not exposed at that threshold; hatched: exposed, no reportable count; colors capped at ±25%") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "right")
p_s3
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure5_county_phase_vs_expected.png"), p_s3,
       width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_s3_pdf <- jesee_lines(p_s3, 0.75) + labs(caption = NULL) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 9.8),
        legend.ticks = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.75)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barheight = grid::unit(5, "cm"), display = "gradient"))
hatch_i <- which(vapply(p_s3_pdf$layers, function(l) identical(l$data, s3_hatch), logical(1)))
if (length(hatch_i) == 1) p_s3_pdf$layers[[hatch_i]]$data <- hatch_sf(s3_nocount, spacing = 15000)  # wider spacing so 1 pt hatch lines stay open
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure5_county_phase_vs_expected.pdf"), p_s3_pdf,
       width = 10, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")

phase_ratio |>
  dplyr::group_by(threshold, effect) |>
  dplyr::summarize(counties = dplyr::n(),
                   min = round(min(pct_diff), 1),
                   median = round(median(pct_diff), 1),
                   max = round(max(pct_diff), 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  as.data.frame()
```

The geography statements in the Results come from the county values behind Figure 5. Counties are classified as metropolitan (USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes 1–3) or nonmetropolitan (codes 4–9).
