## Attributable fraction and number (Table 1)

The attributable fraction is AF = 1 − exp(−β) and the attributable number is AN = n × AF, where β is the phase coefficient and n is the number of encounters observed in that phase at ≥34 kt (Gasparrini & Leone 2014). Confidence limits come from the limits of β. The all-cause β comes from `m_allcause`. The cause-specific β is recovered from the percent change, β = log(1 + %/100), which is exact. Impact coverage is the share of exposed county-storm pairs (those with a Threat row) that also have an Impact row; suppressed single-day cells are absent from the provider files.
```{r}
ar_threshold <- 34L

phase_n <- function(df) {
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == ar_threshold) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect_label = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                      ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect_label), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::group_by(effect_label) |>
    dplyr::summarize(n = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

ar_allcause <- broom::tidy(m_allcause, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Outcome = "All-cause",
                   effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                   beta = estimate, beta_lo = conf.low, beta_hi = conf.high, p.value) |>
  dplyr::left_join(phase_n(ED_allcause), by = "effect_label")

ar_category <- disease_results_all |>
  dplyr::filter(threshold_knots == ar_threshold, !is.na(effect_label)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Outcome = cat_labels[Category], Category, effect_label,
                   beta = log(1 + pct_change / 100),
                   beta_lo = log(1 + pct_ci_lo / 100),
                   beta_hi = log(1 + pct_ci_hi / 100),
                   p.value) |>
  dplyr::left_join(ED_disease |>
                     dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
                     dplyr::group_modify(~ phase_n(.x)) |>
                     dplyr::ungroup(),
                   by = c("Category", "effect_label"))

impact_coverage <- ED_disease |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == ar_threshold,
                lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
  dplyr::summarize(pairs        = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(SID, County)[Window == "Threat_7d"]),
                   impact_pairs = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(SID, County)[Window == "Landfall_Day0"]),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::transmute(Outcome = cat_labels[Category],
                   impact_coverage_pct = round(100 * impact_pairs / pairs))

attributable_risk <- dplyr::bind_rows(ar_allcause, ar_category |> dplyr::select(-Category)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(AF    = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta)),
                AF_lo = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta_lo)),
                AF_hi = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta_hi)),
                AN    = n * AF / 100,
                AN_lo = n * AF_lo / 100,
                AN_hi = n * AF_hi / 100) |>
  dplyr::left_join(impact_coverage, by = "Outcome")

comma <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)

attributable_risk |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect_label = factor(effect_label, levels = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup")),
                Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("All-cause", "Injuries", "Respiratory",
                                                     "Infectious disease", "Neuropsychiatric",
                                                     "Digestive", "Cardiovascular", "Endocrine",
                                                     "Renal", "Diabetes", "Neoplasms"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Outcome, effect_label) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Outcome, phase = effect_label, n = comma(n),
                   AF = sprintf("%+.1f%%", AF),
                   AN = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", comma(AN), comma(AN_lo), comma(AN_hi)),
                   p = signif(p.value, 2),
                   impact_coverage = ifelse(effect_label == "Impact",
                                            paste0(impact_coverage_pct, "%"), "")) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Attributable fraction and number at ≥64 kt (Table 2)

The same calculation at ≥64 kt, where the Cleanup increases are largest; Table 1 above is unchanged. The all-cause β is the ≥64 kt estimate from Figure 2 (`fig_dat`) and the cause-specific β comes from `disease_results_all`, both recovered from the percent change, β = log(1 + %/100), which is exact. The phase totals n and the Impact coverage are counted at ≥64 kt. Run at ≥34 kt, this function reproduces Table 1.
```{r}
attributable_at <- function(th) {
  phase_n_th <- function(df) {
    df |>
      dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == th) |>
      dplyr::mutate(effect_label = dplyr::case_when(
        Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
        Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                      ~ "Impact",
        !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
        TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect_label), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
      dplyr::group_by(effect_label) |>
      dplyr::summarize(n = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }
  from_pct <- function(df) df |>
    dplyr::mutate(beta = log(1 + pct_change / 100), beta_lo = log(1 + pct_ci_lo / 100),
                  beta_hi = log(1 + pct_ci_hi / 100))

  ac <- fig_dat |>
    dplyr::filter(as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", as.character(threshold))) == th) |>
    from_pct() |>
    dplyr::transmute(Outcome = "All-cause", effect_label = as.character(effect_label),
                     beta, beta_lo, beta_hi, p.value) |>
    dplyr::left_join(phase_n_th(ED_allcause), by = "effect_label")

  cs <- disease_results_all |>
    dplyr::filter(threshold_knots == th, !is.na(effect_label)) |>
    from_pct() |>
    dplyr::transmute(Outcome = cat_labels[Category], Category, effect_label,
                     beta, beta_lo, beta_hi, p.value) |>
    dplyr::left_join(ED_disease |>
                       dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
                       dplyr::group_modify(~ phase_n_th(.x)) |>
                       dplyr::ungroup(),
                     by = c("Category", "effect_label"))

  coverage <- ED_disease |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == th,
                  lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
    dplyr::summarize(pairs        = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(SID, County)[Window == "Threat_7d"]),
                     impact_pairs = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(SID, County)[Window == "Landfall_Day0"]),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::transmute(Outcome = cat_labels[Category],
                     impact_coverage_pct = round(100 * impact_pairs / pairs))

  dplyr::bind_rows(ac, cs |> dplyr::select(-Category)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(AF    = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta)),
                  AF_lo = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta_lo)),
                  AF_hi = 100 * (1 - exp(-beta_hi)),
                  AN    = n * AF / 100,
                  AN_lo = n * AF_lo / 100,
                  AN_hi = n * AF_hi / 100) |>
    dplyr::left_join(coverage, by = "Outcome")
}

# check: at ≥34 kt the function must reproduce Table 1
chk_34 <- attributable_at(34L) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(attributable_risk, by = c("Outcome", "effect_label"))
stopifnot(nrow(chk_34) == nrow(attributable_risk),
          max(abs(c(chk_34$AN.x - chk_34$AN.y, chk_34$AF.x - chk_34$AF.y))) < 1e-6)

attributable_risk_64 <- attributable_at(64L)

attributable_risk_64 |>
  dplyr::mutate(effect_label = factor(effect_label, levels = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup")),
                Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("All-cause", "Injuries", "Respiratory",
                                                     "Infectious disease", "Neuropsychiatric",
                                                     "Digestive", "Cardiovascular", "Endocrine",
                                                     "Renal", "Diabetes", "Neoplasms"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Outcome, effect_label) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Outcome, phase = effect_label, n = comma(n),
                   AF = sprintf("%+.1f%%", AF),
                   AN = sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", comma(AN), comma(AN_lo), comma(AN_hi)),
                   p = signif(p.value, 2),
                   impact_coverage = ifelse(effect_label == "Impact",
                                            paste0(impact_coverage_pct, "%"), "")) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Threat phase without a swath (Note used)

The Discussion compares the Threat phase across the swath definition. Two models are fit at each threshold with the statewide file, which assigns every storm's phases to all 67 counties. The first ignores the swath: every county is exposed to every storm. The second splits the Threat phase into counties inside the swath (ThreatIn) and counties outside it (ThreatOut); the Impact and Cleanup phases stay inside the swath. A county-week that is a Threat week for one storm inside its swath and for another storm outside its swath is counted as inside. In both models the storm-active weeks for every county are removed from the None weeks.
```{r}
statewide_threat <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, fit_allcause_threshold,
                                   threat_window = "Threat_7d",
                                   n_cleanup     = n_cleanup_weeks,
                                   ed            = ED_allcause_state) |>
  dplyr::mutate(exposure = "All counties (no swath)")

fit_threat_inside_outside <- function(thresh) {
  in_swath <- swath_county |>
    dplyr::filter(threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::transmute(SID, ahca_code, in_swath = TRUE)

  storm_obs_t <- ED_allcause_state |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == thresh) |>
    dplyr::mutate(phase = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
      Window == "Landfall_Day0"                                      ~ "Impact",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(phase), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County) |>
    dplyr::left_join(in_swath, by = c("SID", "ahca_code")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(in_swath = !is.na(in_swath)) |>
    dplyr::filter(in_swath | phase == "Threat") |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, window_start, phase) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(in_swath), dplyr::desc(Visits), .by_group = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::slice(1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(phase == "Threat" & in_swath ~ "ThreatIn",
                                            phase == "Threat"            ~ "ThreatOut",
                                            TRUE                         ~ phase),
                  year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month"))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, Visits, window_days, effect, year_month)

  mask_t <- build_disease_mask(thresh, n_cleanup_weeks, ed = ED_allcause_state) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)

  none_t <- weekly_allcause_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(Visits > 42, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_t, by = c("ahca_code", "week_mon")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active), lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect = "None",
                     year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))

  panel_t <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_obs_t, none_t) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "ThreatIn", "ThreatOut",
                                                         "Impact", "Cleanup")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))

  fit <- fixest::fepois(
    Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
    offset  = ~ log(window_days),
    data    = panel_t,
    cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month
  )

  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  k <- c("effect::ThreatIn", "effect::ThreatOut")
  d    <- unname(b[k[1]] - b[k[2]])
  d_se <- sqrt(V[k[1], k[1]] + V[k[2], k[2]] - 2 * V[k[1], k[2]])

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::filter(term %in% k) |>
    dplyr::transmute(threshold = thresh,
                     effect_label = sub("effect::", "", term),
                     n_obs = as.integer(table(panel_t$effect)[effect_label]),
                     pct_change = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
                     pct_ci_lo  = 100 * (exp(conf.low) - 1),
                     pct_ci_hi  = 100 * (exp(conf.high) - 1),
                     p.value,
                     in_minus_out_pct = 100 * (exp(d) - 1),
                     in_vs_out_p      = 2 * pnorm(-abs(d / d_se)))
}

threat_inside_outside <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, fit_threat_inside_outside)

statewide_threat |>
  dplyr::filter(effect_label == "Threat") |>
  as.data.frame()
as.data.frame(threat_inside_outside)
```

## Falsification test (timing permutation)

Each storm's impact date is moved to a random day in the same hurricane season (May–November of the same year) at least 16 days from the true date, the phase windows are rebuilt around the new date from the daily file, the storm-active weeks are removed from the None weeks, and the all-cause model is refit. This is repeated 200 times at ≥34 kt. The one-sided empirical p-value is the share of permuted estimates at least as extreme as the true estimate, (1 + count) / (200 + 1).
```{r}
set.seed(20250528)
N_ITER <- 200
placebo_threshold <- 34L

daily_all <- readr::read_csv(daily_allcause_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Date = as.Date(Date), ahca_code = as.integer(County)) |>
  dplyr::filter(ahca_code != 99,
                Date >= as.Date(paste0(begin_year, "-01-01")),
                Date <= as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-12-31")))

storm_county_exposure <- ED_allcause |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == placebo_threshold) |>
  dplyr::distinct(SID, County, impact_date) |>
  dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County, true_impact = impact_date)

true_coefs <- broom::tidy(m_allcause) |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                   true_estimate = estimate,
                   true_pct = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
                   true_p = p.value)

run_temporal_permutation <- function(iter) {
  randomized <- storm_county_exposure |>
    dplyr::distinct(SID, true_impact) |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(yr           = lubridate::year(true_impact),
                  season_start = as.Date(paste0(yr, "-05-01")),
                  season_end   = as.Date(paste0(yr, "-11-30")),
                  rand_impact  = {
                    candidates <- seq(season_start, season_end, by = "day")
                    candidates <- candidates[abs(as.integer(candidates - true_impact)) >= 16]
                    if (length(candidates) == 0) true_impact else sample(candidates, 1)
                  }) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(SID, rand_impact)

  storm_rand <- storm_county_exposure |>
    dplyr::left_join(randomized, by = "SID")

  all_windows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    storm_rand |> dplyr::mutate(window_start = rand_impact - 7L, window_end = rand_impact - 1L,
                                effect = "Threat"),
    storm_rand |> dplyr::mutate(window_start = rand_impact, window_end = rand_impact,
                                effect = "Impact"),
    storm_rand |> dplyr::mutate(window_start = rand_impact + 1L, window_end = rand_impact + 7L,
                                effect = "Cleanup"))

  storm_obs_rand <- all_windows |>
    dplyr::inner_join(daily_all, by = "ahca_code", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    dplyr::filter(Date >= window_start, Date <= window_end) |>
    dplyr::group_by(SID, ahca_code, effect, window_start, window_end) |>
    dplyr::summarize(Visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), window_days = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

  storm_active_rand <- all_windows |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(dates = list(seq(window_start, window_end, by = "day"))) |>
    tidyr::unnest(dates) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(dates, unit = "week", week_start = 1))) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE)

  none_rand <- daily_all |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(Date, unit = "week", week_start = 1))) |>
    dplyr::group_by(ahca_code, week_mon) |>
    dplyr::summarize(Visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), n_days = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n_days == 7, Visits > 42, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::left_join(storm_active_rand, by = c("ahca_code", "week_mon")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect       = "None",
                  window_days  = 7L,
                  window_start = week_mon,
                  year_month   = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")),
                  county_fe    = factor(as.integer(ahca_code))) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, county_fe, Visits, window_days, effect, window_start, year_month)

  panel_rand <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_obs_rand, none_rand) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect     = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat", "Impact")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month),
                  county_fe  = factor(as.integer(ahca_code)))
  if (nrow(panel_rand) < 100) return(NULL)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                   offset  = ~ log(window_days),
                   data    = panel_rand,
                   cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  broom::tidy(fit) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("effect", term)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(iter = iter, type = "temporal",
                     effect_label = stringr::str_extract(term, "(?<=::)[A-Za-z]+"),
                     estimate, p.value)
}

temporal_coefs <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(N_ITER), run_temporal_permutation))
dplyr::n_distinct(temporal_coefs$iter)
```

Empirical p-values for the all-cause phases.
```{r}
placebo_summary <- temporal_coefs |>
  dplyr::group_by(type, effect_label) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_iter   = n(),
                   mean_est = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_est   = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
                   p2_5     = quantile(estimate, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                   p97_5    = quantile(estimate, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups  = "drop")

compute_emp_p <- function(permutation_estimates, true_estimate, n_iter) {
  if (true_estimate >= 0) {
    p_one <- (1 + sum(permutation_estimates >= true_estimate)) / (n_iter + 1)
  } else {
    p_one <- (1 + sum(permutation_estimates <= true_estimate)) / (n_iter + 1)
  }
  round(p_one, 3)
}

empirical_p <- temporal_coefs |>
  dplyr::left_join(true_coefs |> dplyr::select(effect_label, true_estimate), by = "effect_label") |>
  dplyr::group_by(type, effect_label) |>
  dplyr::summarize(true_estimate  = unique(true_estimate),
                   true_pct       = round(100 * (exp(unique(true_estimate)) - 1), 2),
                   emp_p_onesided = compute_emp_p(estimate, unique(true_estimate), dplyr::n()),
                   .groups = "drop")

as.data.frame(empirical_p)
```

The same timing permutation for each cause-specific category. There are no daily category data, so the random impact weeks are drawn on the provider's Sunday week grid (same year, May–November, at least 16 days from the true date), and the pseudo-Threat and pseudo-Cleanup weeks are scored from the weekly file. The 1-day Impact phase cannot be moved on a weekly grid and is not tested.
```{r}
set.seed(4242)
cat_placebo_threshold <- 34L

sundays_of_year <- function(yr) {
  s <- seq(as.Date(paste0(yr, "-05-01")), as.Date(paste0(yr, "-11-30")), by = "day")
  s[lubridate::wday(s) == 1]
}

emp_p_cat <- function(placebo, true) {
  placebo <- placebo[!is.na(placebo)]
  if (length(placebo) == 0 || is.na(true)) return(NA_real_)
  if (true >= 0) (sum(placebo >= true) + 1) / (length(placebo) + 1)
  else           (sum(placebo <= true) + 1) / (length(placebo) + 1)
}

run_category_placebo <- function(cname) {
  ns <- combined_ns |>
    dplyr::filter(Category == cname) |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_sun = week_mon - 1L) |>
    dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun, Visits)
  sa <- ED_disease |>
    dplyr::filter(Category == cname, County != 99, threshold_knots == cat_placebo_threshold)

  storm_counties <- sa |>
    dplyr::filter(Window == "Threat_7d") |>
    dplyr::transmute(SID, true_impact = as.Date(impact_date), ahca_code = as.integer(County)) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
  storms <- storm_counties |> dplyr::distinct(SID, true_impact)

  storm_true <- sa |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::transmute(ahca_code = as.integer(County), Visits, window_days, effect,
                     year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")))
  none_true <- ns |>
    dplyr::left_join(storm_active_weeks_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect = "None",
                     year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
  panel_true <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_true, none_true) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month), county_fe = factor(ahca_code))

  ft <- tryCatch(fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                                offset = ~ log(window_days), data = panel_true,
                                cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ft)) return(NULL)
  bt <- coef(ft)
  tv <- c(Threat = unname(bt["effect::Threat"]), Cleanup = unname(bt["effect::Cleanup"]))

  temporal_one <- function(i) {
    rand <- storms |>
      dplyr::rowwise() |>
      dplyr::mutate(w0 = {
        cand <- sundays_of_year(lubridate::year(true_impact))
        cand <- cand[abs(as.integer(cand - true_impact)) >= 16 & cand + 7 <= none_end_date]
        if (length(cand) == 0) as.Date(NA) else sample(cand, 1) }) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(w0))
    pseudo <- storm_counties |>
      dplyr::inner_join(rand |> dplyr::select(SID, w0), by = "SID") |>
      dplyr::mutate(threat_wk = w0 - 7L, cleanup_wk = w0 + 7L)
    ps <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      pseudo |> dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, week_sun = threat_wk,  effect = "Threat"),
      pseudo |> dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, week_sun = cleanup_wk, effect = "Cleanup")) |>
      dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun, effect) |>
      dplyr::inner_join(ns, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
      dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
      dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect,
                       year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
    pw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      pseudo |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun = threat_wk),
      pseudo |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun = cleanup_wk)) |>
      dplyr::distinct() |>
      dplyr::mutate(is_pseudo = TRUE)
    none_i <- ns |>
      dplyr::left_join(storm_active_weeks_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
      dplyr::left_join(pw, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::filter(is.na(is_pseudo)) |>
      dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
      dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
      dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect = "None",
                       year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
    p <- dplyr::bind_rows(ps, none_i) |>
      dplyr::mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat")),
                    year_month = factor(year_month), county_fe = factor(ahca_code))
    f <- tryCatch(fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                                 offset = ~ log(window_days), data = p,
                                 cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
    b <- coef(f)
    tibble::tibble(threat = unname(b["effect::Threat"]), cleanup = unname(b["effect::Cleanup"]))
  }

  tr <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(N_ITER), temporal_one))

  tibble::tibble(Category = cname, phase = c("Threat", "Cleanup"),
                 true_pct = 100 * (exp(c(tv["Threat"], tv["Cleanup"])) - 1),
                 temp_p   = c(emp_p_cat(tr$threat, tv["Threat"]),
                              emp_p_cat(tr$cleanup, tv["Cleanup"])))
}

category_placebo_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(sort(unique(ED_disease$Category)), run_category_placebo))

as.data.frame(category_placebo_results)
```

## Falsification test at ≥55 and ≥64 kt and for age groups

The same two timing permutations, extended beyond ≥34 kt: the all-cause test at ≥55 and ≥64 kt, the cause-specific test at ≥55 and ≥64 kt, and the age-group test at all three thresholds. Age groups have only weekly baseline counts, so they use the weekly (Sunday-grid) version, as the categories do. At each threshold the storm rows, the exposed counties, and the storm-active weeks are those of that threshold, and the true estimates are refit at that threshold. The ≥34 kt results above (T8 and T9) are not changed. `run_weekly_placebo()` is `run_category_placebo()` with the storm rows, the weekly baseline, the storm-active weeks, and the threshold passed in; at ≥34 kt it reproduces T9 exactly.
```{r}
run_weekly_placebo <- function(sa, ns, mask_sun, th) {
  sa <- sa |> dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == th)
  storm_counties <- sa |>
    dplyr::filter(Window == "Threat_7d") |>
    dplyr::transmute(SID, true_impact = as.Date(impact_date), ahca_code = as.integer(County)) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
  storms <- storm_counties |> dplyr::distinct(SID, true_impact)

  storm_true <- sa |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dplyr::case_when(
      Window == "Threat_7d"                                          ~ "Threat",
      !is.na(PostWeek) & PostWeek >= 1 & PostWeek <= n_cleanup_weeks ~ "Cleanup",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(effect), lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11) |>
    dplyr::transmute(ahca_code = as.integer(County), Visits, window_days, effect,
                     year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(window_start, "month")))
  none_true <- ns |>
    dplyr::left_join(mask_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
    dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
    dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect = "None",
                     year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
  panel_true <- dplyr::bind_rows(storm_true, none_true) |>
    dplyr::mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat")),
                  year_month = factor(year_month), county_fe = factor(ahca_code))

  ft <- tryCatch(fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                                offset = ~ log(window_days), data = panel_true,
                                cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ft)) return(NULL)
  bt <- coef(ft)
  tv <- c(Threat = unname(bt["effect::Threat"]), Cleanup = unname(bt["effect::Cleanup"]))

  temporal_one <- function(i) {
    rand <- storms |>
      dplyr::rowwise() |>
      dplyr::mutate(w0 = {
        cand <- sundays_of_year(lubridate::year(true_impact))
        cand <- cand[abs(as.integer(cand - true_impact)) >= 16 & cand + 7 <= none_end_date]
        if (length(cand) == 0) as.Date(NA) else sample(cand, 1) }) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(w0))
    pseudo <- storm_counties |>
      dplyr::inner_join(rand |> dplyr::select(SID, w0), by = "SID") |>
      dplyr::mutate(threat_wk = w0 - 7L, cleanup_wk = w0 + 7L)
    ps <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      pseudo |> dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, week_sun = threat_wk,  effect = "Threat"),
      pseudo |> dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, week_sun = cleanup_wk, effect = "Cleanup")) |>
      dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun, effect) |>
      dplyr::inner_join(ns, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
      dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11) |>
      dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect,
                       year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
    pw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      pseudo |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun = threat_wk),
      pseudo |> dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun = cleanup_wk)) |>
      dplyr::distinct() |>
      dplyr::mutate(is_pseudo = TRUE)
    none_i <- ns |>
      dplyr::left_join(mask_sun, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::filter(is.na(storm_active)) |>
      dplyr::left_join(pw, by = c("ahca_code", "week_sun")) |>
      dplyr::filter(is.na(is_pseudo)) |>
      dplyr::mutate(week_mon = week_sun + 1L) |>
      dplyr::filter(lubridate::month(week_mon) %in% 5:11, week_mon <= none_end_date) |>
      dplyr::transmute(ahca_code, Visits, window_days = 7L, effect = "None",
                       year_month = as.character(lubridate::floor_date(week_mon, "month")))
    p <- dplyr::bind_rows(ps, none_i) |>
      dplyr::mutate(effect = factor(effect, levels = c("None", "Cleanup", "Threat")),
                    year_month = factor(year_month), county_fe = factor(ahca_code))
    f <- tryCatch(fixest::fepois(Visits ~ i(effect, ref = "None") | county_fe + year_month,
                                 offset = ~ log(window_days), data = p,
                                 cluster = ~ county_fe + year_month),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
    b <- coef(f)
    tibble::tibble(threat = unname(b["effect::Threat"]), cleanup = unname(b["effect::Cleanup"]))
  }

  tr <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(N_ITER), temporal_one))

  tibble::tibble(phase = c("Threat", "Cleanup"),
                 true_pct = 100 * (exp(c(tv["Threat"], tv["Cleanup"])) - 1),
                 temp_p   = c(emp_p_cat(tr$threat, tv["Threat"]),
                              emp_p_cat(tr$cleanup, tv["Cleanup"])),
                 n_iter   = nrow(tr))
}

# Sunday-keyed storm-active weeks at each threshold
placebo_masks <- lapply(setNames(thresholds, thresholds), function(th)
  build_disease_mask(th, n_cleanup_weeks) |>
    dplyr::distinct(ahca_code, week_sun) |>
    dplyr::mutate(storm_active = TRUE))

weekly_placebo_ext <- list()
for (th in thresholds) {
  ms <- placebo_masks[[as.character(th)]]
  if (th != 34L) {                                   # categories at 34 kt are T9 above
    set.seed(4242)
    for (cn in sort(unique(ED_disease$Category))) {
      r <- run_weekly_placebo(ED_disease |> dplyr::filter(Category == cn),
                              combined_ns |> dplyr::filter(Category == cn) |>
                                dplyr::mutate(week_sun = week_mon - 1L) |>
                                dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun, Visits),
                              ms, th)
      weekly_placebo_ext[[length(weekly_placebo_ext) + 1]] <-
        r |> dplyr::mutate(outcome = unname(cat_labels[cn]), threshold_kt = th, .before = 1)
      invisible(gc())
    }
  }
  set.seed(5151)
  for (a in age_levels) {
    r <- run_weekly_placebo(age_df |> dplyr::filter(SubgroupCol == a),
                            age_ns |> dplyr::filter(SubgroupCol == a) |>
                              dplyr::mutate(week_sun = week_mon - 1L) |>
                              dplyr::select(ahca_code, week_sun, Visits),
                            ms, th)
    weekly_placebo_ext[[length(weekly_placebo_ext) + 1]] <-
      r |> dplyr::mutate(outcome = paste("Age", a), threshold_kt = th, .before = 1)
    invisible(gc())
  }
}
weekly_placebo_ext <- dplyr::bind_rows(weekly_placebo_ext)

# all-cause daily test at 55 and 64 kt: run_temporal_permutation() reads storm_county_exposure
storm_county_exposure_34 <- storm_county_exposure
allcause_placebo_ext <- list()
for (th in c(55L, 64L)) {
  storm_county_exposure <- ED_allcause |>
    dplyr::filter(County != 99, threshold_knots == th) |>
    dplyr::distinct(SID, County, impact_date) |>
    dplyr::rename(ahca_code = County, true_impact = impact_date)
  set.seed(20250528)
  tc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(N_ITER), run_temporal_permutation))
  tru <- fig_dat |>
    dplyr::filter(as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", as.character(threshold))) == th) |>
    dplyr::transmute(effect_label = as.character(effect_label),
                     true_beta = log(1 + pct_change / 100))
  allcause_placebo_ext[[as.character(th)]] <- tc |>
    dplyr::left_join(tru, by = "effect_label") |>
    dplyr::group_by(effect_label) |>
    dplyr::summarize(threshold_kt = th,
                     n_iter       = dplyr::n(),
                     true_pct     = 100 * (exp(dplyr::first(true_beta)) - 1),
                     emp_p        = compute_emp_p(estimate, dplyr::first(true_beta), dplyr::n()),
                     placebo_mean_pct = 100 * (exp(mean(estimate)) - 1),
                     placebo_sd   = sd(estimate),
                     .groups = "drop")
  invisible(gc())
}
allcause_placebo_ext <- dplyr::bind_rows(allcause_placebo_ext)
storm_county_exposure <- storm_county_exposure_34

as.data.frame(allcause_placebo_ext)
as.data.frame(weekly_placebo_ext)
```

## Results tables

Collect every number reported in the manuscript and write each table to `outputs/results_tables/`.
```{r}
tab_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "results_tables")
dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

emit <- function(df, file) {
  readr::write_csv(df, file.path(tab_dir, file))
  as.data.frame(df)
}
phase_ord <- function(x) factor(x, levels = c("Threat", "Impact", "Cleanup"))
```

Storms and counties by wind threshold (Methods)
```{r}
ED_allcause |>
  dplyr::filter(County != 99, lubridate::month(window_start) %in% 5:11, !is.na(Visits)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(threshold_kt = threshold_knots) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_storms     = dplyr::n_distinct(SID),
                   first_impact = min(impact_date, na.rm = TRUE),
                   last_impact  = max(impact_date, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_counties   = dplyr::n_distinct(County),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  emit("T1_study_inventory.csv")
```

Analytic panel at ≥34 kt (Methods)
```{r}
ED_panel |>
  dplyr::group_by(phase = as.character(effect)) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_obs        = dplyr::n(),
                   total_visits = sum(Visits, na.rm = TRUE),
                   mean_visits  = round(mean(Visits, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  emit("T2_panel_composition.csv")
```

All-cause phase effects (Results 3.1, Figure 2)
```{r}
fig_dat |>
  dplyr::transmute(threshold = as.character(threshold),
                   phase = phase_ord(as.character(effect_label)),
                   pct_change, ci_low = pct_ci_lo, ci_high = pct_ci_hi, p_value = p.value) |>
  dplyr::arrange(threshold, phase) |>
  emit("T3_allcause_phase_effects.csv")
```

attributable_risk |>
